section: National - new central schemes, missions and their features
subsections: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)
Scheme features - launch year, objective, outlay (PURVODAYA, Khelo India, MISHTI)
Campaigns and abhiyans → launching body + aim + target group
Missions - name, ministry, target year, components
Programme acronyms and portals → full form + ministry + purpose (APAAR, NSQF)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan:
1. It is associated with the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
2. It is a Central Sector scheme.
3. It aims to train 20 lakh grassroots Adi Karmayogis across one lakh tribal villages.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan is a Central Sector initiative of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs. It envisages training 20 lakh grassroots Adi Karmayogis across one lakh tribal villages.
accepted.tq: Combine ministry, scheme type and numerical targets, checking whether all three statements fit the same programme.
accepted.sec: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)

accepted.s:
Project BHISHM is primarily associated with which of the following?

1. Portable cubes functioning as mobile hospitals
2. The Aarogya Maitri initiative
3. Provision of two such cubes to Sri Lanka

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Project BHISHM, under Aarogya Maitri, consists of portable cubes that function as mobile hospitals. Two such cubes were given to Sri Lanka.
accepted.tq: Use the scheme’s distinctive equipment, parent initiative and international recipient as linked clues.
accepted.sec: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)

accepted.s: The Immigration, Visa, Foreigners Registration and Tracking (IVFRT) programme is implemented by which combination?
o: Bureau of Immigration and National Informatics Centre
Bureau of Police Research and Development and UIDAI
accepted.x: IVFRT is under the Ministry of Home Affairs and is implemented through the Bureau of Immigration and the National Informatics Centre. Its extension is up to March 2031.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure implementing-agency pair and reject agencies belonging to neighbouring schemes.
accepted.sec: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)

accepted.s: The PM SVANidhi scheme is associated with which implementing agency?
accepted.x: PM SVANidhi is associated with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs and the Department of Financial Services, with SIDBI as the implementing agency.
accepted.tq: Identify the implementing institution rather than the nodal ministry.
accepted.sec: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)

accepted.s: GOBARdhan, now known as the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme, was moved to which Union Ministry?
o: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: GOBARdhan was moved to the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. The scheme received an approved outlay of ₹23,731 crore for FY 2027–FY 2036.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘which ministry’ trap by distinguishing the present ministry from related rural and renewable-energy ministries.
accepted.sec: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)

accepted.s: MY Bharat was launched on 31 October 2023 as a replacement for which organisation?
accepted.x: MY Bharat was launched on 31 October 2023 under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, replacing the Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan, established in 1972.
accepted.tq: Use the launch date and predecessor organisation to distinguish the youth programme from similar bodies.
accepted.sec: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)

accepted.s: Rashtriya Uchchतर Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA), concerning higher education, now continues in which form?
accepted.x: RUSA, the higher-education scheme of the Ministry of Human Resource Development, now continues as PM-USHA. PM-USHA links central grants with compliance with NEP 2020.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similarly named education programmes by matching the higher-education scheme with its successor.
accepted.sec: Schemes/projects → nodal ministry + implementing agency (BHISHM, RUSA, YUVA, Adi Karmayogi)

accepted.s: Which of the following States is NOT included among the eastern States covered by the PURVODAYA development plan?
accepted.x: PURVODAYA covers Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh. Chhattisgarh is not included in this listed group.
accepted.tq: Find the outsider by checking every option against the complete geographical list.
accepted.sec: Scheme features - launch year, objective, outlay (PURVODAYA, Khelo India, MISHTI)

accepted.s: Which one of the following was added to PURVODAYA in Budget 2026–27?
o: A Himalayan Industrial Corridor with a node at Dehradun
A North-East Industrial Corridor with a node at Guwahati
An East Coast Industrial Corridor with a node at Durgapur
A West Coast Industrial Corridor with a node at Surat
accepted.x: Budget 2026–27 added an East Coast Industrial Corridor with a node at Durgapur to the PURVODAYA framework. It also provided for five tourism destinations and 4,000 e-buses.
accepted.tq: Use the location-and-node pair as the decisive clue in a scheme-feature question.
accepted.sec: Scheme features - launch year, objective, outlay (PURVODAYA, Khelo India, MISHTI)

accepted.s: Khelo India was originally launched in which year?
accepted.x: The Khelo India programme was launched in 2018. Its later revision includes feeder schools, Utkrishta Vidyalayas and a target of making India a top-ten sporting nation by 2036.
accepted.tq: Test the launch year directly using closely spaced chronological distractors.
accepted.sec: Scheme features - launch year, objective, outlay (PURVODAYA, Khelo India, MISHTI)

accepted.s: Under the revised Khelo India arrangements, infrastructure costs are generally shared in which ratio, with a special ratio for the North-Eastern and Himalayan States?
o: 90:10 generally and 60:40 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States
60:40 generally and 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States
50:50 generally and 75:25 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States
75:25 generally and 60:40 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States
accepted.x: Khelo India infrastructure costs are shared in a 60:40 ratio in general, while the ratio is 90:10 for the North-Eastern and Himalayan States.
accepted.tq: Separate the general funding ratio from the special regional ratio before comparing options.
accepted.sec: Scheme features - launch year, objective, outlay (PURVODAYA, Khelo India, MISHTI)

accepted.s: Which of the following is a new feature associated with the revamped Khelo India programme?
o: PM Sports Universities exclusively for each district
accepted.x: Khelo India Feeder Schools and Utkrishta Vidyalayas are new features of the revamped programme. The programme also targets India’s emergence as a top-ten sporting nation by 2036.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official programme term rather than a plausible but non-existent institutional label.
accepted.sec: Scheme features - launch year, objective, outlay (PURVODAYA, Khelo India, MISHTI)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding MISHTI:
1. MISHTI stands for Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes.
2. It has been extended up to 2029.
3. Its total outlay after the additional allocation is ₹600 crore.
4. Andhra Pradesh ranked second among the States under the initiative.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: MISHTI expands to Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes. It has been extended to 2029, received ₹500 crore more to reach a total of ₹600 crore, and Andhra Pradesh ranked second among States.
accepted.tq: Check the acronym, extension year, revised outlay and State ranking as separate factual components.
accepted.sec: Scheme features - launch year, objective, outlay (PURVODAYA, Khelo India, MISHTI)

accepted.s: Rashtriya Avishkar Abhiyan was launched by President Pranab Mukherjee on 9 July 2015 with the objective of promoting which subjects among school children?
accepted.x: Rashtriya Avishkar Abhiyan was launched by President Pranab Mukherjee on 9 July 2015 to promote science and mathematics among school children.
accepted.tq: Link the launching authority, date and objective without confusing the target subjects.
accepted.sec: Campaigns and abhiyans → launching body + aim + target group

accepted.s: Unnat Bharat Abhiyan seeks to establish a functional link between higher educational institutions and which of the following?
accepted.x: Unnat Bharat Abhiyan, associated with the Ministry of Human Resource Development, links IITs, NITs and IISERs with villages.
accepted.tq: Infer the programme’s target area from the stated institutional-to-community linkage.
accepted.sec: Campaigns and abhiyans → launching body + aim + target group

accepted.s: Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 was launched by which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
accepted.x: Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 was launched by the Ministry of Culture. It was scheduled from 9 to 17 August 2026 under the theme ‘Spirit of Vande Mataram’, including the SURYAPATH TIRANGA flag relay across Indian Missions.
accepted.tq: Use the launching ministry as the primary discriminator in a current-affairs scheme question.
accepted.sec: Campaigns and abhiyans → launching body + aim + target group

accepted.s: The Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan primarily targets which group?
accepted.x: The campaign targets drug-free youth. It is associated with the Prime Minister and the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports through MY Bharat, and follows a 100-week Jan Bhagidari plan based on the Kashi Declaration.
accepted.tq: Match the campaign’s name with its clearly specified target group and implementing channel.
accepted.sec: Campaigns and abhiyans → launching body + aim + target group

accepted.s: The Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra was launched from Khunti in Jharkhand on which date?
accepted.x: The Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra was launched by the Prime Minister on 15 November 2023 at Khunti, Jharkhand, with the objective of achieving last-mile saturation of government schemes.
accepted.tq: Combine place, date and objective to avoid confusing this yatra with other national campaigns.
accepted.sec: Campaigns and abhiyans → launching body + aim + target group

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. Nayi Disha — Delhi Police initiative to bring school dropouts back
2. Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan — Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
3. Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan — implemented through the National Institute of Social Defence

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Nayi Disha is a Delhi Police initiative for bringing school dropouts back. Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan is associated with the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and is run through the National Institute of Social Defence.
accepted.tq: Match each campaign with its implementing body and purpose before selecting the code.
accepted.sec: Campaigns and abhiyans → launching body + aim + target group

accepted.s: The Jal Jeevan Mission was launched in which year?
accepted.x: The Jal Jeevan Mission was launched in 2019 under the Ministry of Jal Shakti. It has been extended to December 2028 to cover all 19.36 crore rural households.
accepted.tq: Test the launch year using adjacent years as chronological distractors.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: Which ministry is associated with the Jal Jeevan Mission?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
accepted.x: The Jal Jeevan Mission is administered by the Ministry of Jal Shakti. Its revised outlay is ₹8.69 lakh crore and its coverage target is all rural households by December 2028.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who handles this subject’ method to distinguish the water ministry from related ministries.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: Under the Jal Jeevan Mission, the funding pattern for the Himalayan and North-Eastern States is:
accepted.x: The Jal Jeevan Mission follows a 90:10 funding pattern for the Himalayan and North-Eastern States. For other States, the pattern is 50:50.
accepted.tq: Separate regional funding exceptions from the general funding pattern.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: Gyan Bharatam Mission, announced in July 2025, is administered by which ministry?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
accepted.x: Gyan Bharatam Mission is administered by the Ministry of Culture. It has an outlay of ₹491.66 crore for 2025–31 and aims to digitise more than one crore manuscripts.
accepted.tq: Match the manuscript-preservation objective with the appropriate cultural ministry.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: What is the primary objective of the Gyan Bharatam Mission?
o: To establish one crore public libraries
To translate all school textbooks into regional languages
To digitise land records in one crore villages
To digitise more than one crore manuscripts
accepted.x: The Gyan Bharatam Mission aims to digitise more than one crore manuscripts. The National Manuscript Survey recorded 1.19 crore manuscripts by March 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact object of digitisation from other cultural and administrative digitisation programmes.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: The target period of the National Quantum Mission is:
accepted.x: The National Quantum Mission is implemented by the Department of Science and Technology for the period 2023–24 to 2030–31. It envisages quantum machines ranging from 50 to 1,000 qubits.
accepted.tq: Read the beginning and terminal years carefully, especially where the period spans multiple financial years.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: The National Quantum Mission envisages the development of quantum machines in which range?
accepted.x: The National Quantum Mission targets quantum machines in the range of 50 to 1,000 qubits. It is associated with the Department of Science and Technology.
accepted.tq: Test the quantitative range directly, using scale-based distractors from the same subject area.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the present structure of the Swachh Bharat Mission?
o: Only SBM-G Phase II is continuing
SBM-G Phase I and SBM-U 1.0 are continuing without revision
SBM-G Phase II and SBM-U 2.0 are continuing
accepted.x: The Swachh Bharat Mission, launched on 2 October 2014, now operates through SBM-G Phase II and SBM-U 2.0. It is associated with the Ministry of Jal Shakti and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current phases from the original launch phase by focusing on the suffixes and sector labels.
accepted.sec: Missions - name, ministry, target year, components

accepted.s: APAAR is the acronym for:
accepted.x: APAAR stands for Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry. It is the Ministry of Education’s lifelong student identification system.
accepted.tq: Expand the exact official acronym, rejecting plausible substitutions of the key words.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms and portals → full form + ministry + purpose (APAAR, NSQF)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding APAAR:
1. It is a lifelong student ID associated with the Ministry of Education.
2. It is linked to the Academic Bank of Credits.
3. The Academic Bank of Credits has 2,963 registered institutions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: APAAR is the Ministry of Education’s lifelong student ID and is linked to the Academic Bank of Credits. The Academic Bank of Credits has 2,963 registered institutions.
accepted.tq: Check the identity system, its linked platform and the supporting numerical fact together.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms and portals → full form + ministry + purpose (APAAR, NSQF)

accepted.s: NSQF stands for:
accepted.x: NSQF means National Skills Qualification Framework. Skill India certificates are mapped to NSQF and linked to DigiLocker.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similar expansions by retaining the exact terms ‘Skills’ and ‘Qualification’.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms and portals → full form + ministry + purpose (APAAR, NSQF)

accepted.s: Which of the following statements correctly describes the relationship between Skill India certificates and NSQF?
o: Skill India certificates are mapped to NSQF and linked to DigiLocker.
Skill India certificates are issued only through the Academic Bank of Credits.
NSQF certificates cannot be linked to any digital repository.
NSQF is used exclusively for school examination certificates.
accepted.x: Skill India certificates are mapped to the National Skills Qualification Framework and linked to DigiLocker. NSQF is not limited to school examinations or the Academic Bank of Credits.
accepted.tq: Apply the framework’s practical function rather than merely expanding its acronym.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms and portals → full form + ministry + purpose (APAAR, NSQF)

accepted.s: VB-G RAM G is the abbreviated form of which programme?
o: Village Bharat - Gram Rozgar and Agriculture Mission (Gramin)
Viksit Bharat - Guaranteed Rural Assets Mission (General)
Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
Vikas Bharat - Gram Ration and Awas Mission (Gramin)
accepted.x: VB-G RAM G expands to Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin).
accepted.tq: Expand each acronym segment in sequence and reject look-alike substitutions.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms and portals → full form + ministry + purpose (APAAR, NSQF)

accepted.s: Sampada is best described as which of the following?
o: A property e-registration portal of Madhya Pradesh
accepted.x: Sampada is the property e-registration portal of Madhya Pradesh. It is distinct from APAAR, DigiLocker and water-sector portals.
accepted.tq: Identify the portal’s State and administrative purpose instead of being misled by its generic name.
accepted.sec: Programme acronyms and portals → full form + ministry + purpose (APAAR, NSQF)
